newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 48 of February 19, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 48 of February 19, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 24 January 1997 authorizing the indelible printing of prescribed information on packages of seed of oil and fibre plants and amending Decision 87/309/EEC authorizing the indelible printing of prescribed information on packages of certain fodder plant species (97/125/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 30 July 1996 concerning State aid to Werkstoff-Union GmbH, Lippendorf (Saxony) (Only the German text is authentic) (97/124/ECSC)
COMMISSION DIRECTIVE 97/8/EC of 7 February 1997 amending Council Directive 74/63/EEC on undesirable substances and products in animal nutrition (Text with EEA relevance)

DIRECTIVE 96/84/EC OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 19 December 1996 amending Directive 89/398/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to foodstuffs intended for particular nutritional uses
DIRECTIVE 96/83/EC OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 19 December 1996 amending Directive 94/35/EC on sweeteners for use in foodstuffs
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 291/97 of 18 February 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 290/97 of 18 February 1997 fixing the export refunds on poultrymeat
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 289/97 of 18 February 1997 subjecting the issue of import licences for processed tomatoes originating in Turkey to special conditions

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 288/97 of 17 February 1997 amending Annex I to Council Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87 on the tariff and statistical nomenclature and on the Common Customs Tariff and repealing a number of regulations on classification
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 287/97 of 17 February 1997 concerning the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 286/97 of 17 February 1997 concerning the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 285/97 of 17 February 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 738/92 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of cotton yarn originating in Brazil and Turkey END OF DOCUMENT.
